PLAN THE WORK

Style and warmth need to work together.

The space available on a wall is only one part of choosing a radiator. The heat the room needs, the system temperature and the pipe connections also matter.

A new towel rail can be an important part of a bathroom plan. Check whether it can provide the room’s required heating or whether another heat source is needed. If you are buying your own radiator, confirm suitability before ordering.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Can I choose my own radiator?

Yes, but have the output, dimensions, valves and connections checked before buying.

Can a radiator be moved?

Often it can, subject to the pipe route and access. Share a photo of its current position and where you want it to go.
